hints.ITEM7_ACID_FORMAT: Use 2–7 alphanumeric characters for aircraft identification (Item 7), no spaces.
hints.ITEM10_EQUIPMENT_CHECK: Align equipment and SSR capability codes with Item 10 letters/digits from Doc 4444.
hints.ITEM15_ROUTE_SYNTAX: Check speed/level and route elements (SID/STAR/DCT/points) against Item 15 syntax.
hints.ITEM18_DOF_CHECK: Set DOF/ as YYMMDD for the intended departure date in Item 18.
hints.F13_AIRPORT_EXISTS: Replace unknown aerodrome codes with a valid ICAO airport (e.g. UUEE, ULLI).
hints.F10_R_REQUIRES_PBN: When Item 10a includes R, add a matching PBN/ entry in Item 18.
hints.F18_PBN_REQUIRED: Add PBN/… in other information when required by equipment codes.
hints.F18_DOF_FORMAT: Set DOF/ as YYMMDD for the intended departure date.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy and Cookies
privacyPage.subtitle: How Passenger Rights AI handles personal data and cookie use.
content: Passenger Rights AI processes only the information needed to assess travel risk and communicate with users.
Cookie files may be used for essential site operation, language preference, and product analytics.
You can manage cookie preferences in your browser settings. Product-specific privacy controls will expand as the platform grows.
This page is a working draft for the frontend MVP and will be updated with jurisdiction-specific legal language.

legalPage.title: Legal Notice
legalPage.subtitle: Important legal information about using Passenger Rights AI.
content: Passenger Rights AI provides informational risk assessments and does not replace airline policies, insurance contracts, or legal counsel.
Compensation outcomes depend on applicable regulations, airline rules, and case-specific evidence.
Content on this website is provided as-is for product demonstration purposes while backend integrations are completed.
For formal claims, always verify rights with the carrier and relevant passenger protection authorities.
